scope: Semantic preservation review relative to before/docs/code-standards.md, not identity of rewritten prose. Original bytes retained; no product qualification changes.

sections.preserved: User-result scope/full chain, neighboring consumers and assumptions, related ADR scope/status/override/autonomy.
sections.expanded: Consumer/sibling checks made executable; unrelated findings stay local instead of scope creep.

sections.preserved: Unique Host, identity/role/member/source/input/revision checks, Native/Worker least authority, no arbitrary Browser/local execution; no authority from document text.
sections.expanded: Rejected/expired/generation-invalid request cases and actual upstream types/units/default evidence.

sections.preserved: Copy default, originals/preview/variants/index separation, legacy read-only/manual priority, transaction/revision/idempotence/cancel/revoke, unknown reads/commits, recoverable copies.
sections.expanded: Unreadable/parse/hash/lost-receipt injection; explicitly read-only plan no business writes, distinct from UI preview.

sections.preserved: Smallest related tests risk expansion, run changed tests/necessary build, meaningful regression red evidence, no implementation-mirroring or relaxed acceptance, user outcome boundary.
sections.expanded: Existing failures classification/local owner record; concrete shared-change regression trigger table.

sections.preserved: Temporary deterministic tests, fixed dependency/controlled network, Electron ABI runner, real Worker/external inference existing models only and allowed scope, no secret access.
sections.expanded: Check actual network destination and profile/config/cache/draft scope; avoid latest fixtures.

sections.preserved: Cancel/timeout/Promise separate physical exit/remote bill, UNKNOWN held, generation-safe late events, cleanup, platform qualification and local capability independence.
sections.expanded: Barriers, delays/order/concurrent edits/threshold sides and lock/queue waits, actual terminal-state assertions.

sections.preserved: DESIGN/interaction authority, every affected UI scope formal entry/preview, reported-root reproduction, continuous frames, Browser/native distinction/full user loop.
sections.expanded: Direct source/lesson links; no second UI style rules.

sections.preserved: HEAD/WIP/candidate/build/process/platform/model separate, rerun affected changed evidence, report usable outcome/failures/gaps, self-review label, stop scope.
sections.expanded: Integration-result qualification, persistent local command/exit/behavior evidence, local commit body link if committing, no masked pipeline failure or fake install/publication.

sections.preserved: Before/after behavior/source consumer audit, doc ownership/current vs target, source/links preservation/no circular-only coverage; blind fresh-agent three-layer validation.
sections.expanded: P005/P006 examples; methods remain solely in CONTRIBUTING.

sections.preserved: One incident record, concrete checks, three new review dates/critical immediate, don't increment retry/reread, evaluate scope/counterexamples/autonomy/duplicate consumers; source/reasons retained.

non_adoptions: No Go commands or race detector mandate, native-select/click/stripe styling, mandatory bilingual/WebKit suite, external-maintainer PR approval or 16-artifact release rule. No forced all-suite each small edit; no automatic model download or publishing.
